1 Executive Summary & Platform Mission

Bridging the technology divide for 10M+ Pakistani smallholder farmers

1.1 Project Mission & Macro Impact

Kisan Dost (کسان دوست) is an enterprise-grade agricultural operating system engineered specifically to resolve systemic challenges across Pakistan's agricultural ecosystem: fragmented mandi pricing, unpredictable climatic volatility, pest outbreaks, and suboptimal fertilizer application.

By combining high-resolution satellite telemetry from Open-Meteo, multimodal artificial intelligence via Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, real-time commodities market intelligence, and serverless PostgreSQL, Kisan Dost delivers localized, actionable agronomy directly into the hands of farmers across Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and Balochistan.

💡
Bilingual Human-Centric Design
Kisan Dost features seamless single-click language switching between English and Urdu (اردو). All AI responses, error alerts, telemetry notices, and agricultural terms adapt dynamically without destabilizing interface layouts.

3 Stateful 15-Minute Inactivity Session Engine

Security enforcement against shared device vulnerability in rural environments

3.1 The Rural Threat Model & Inactivity Requirement

In rural farming communities, devices are frequently shared across farm managers, cooperative workers, or accessed at shared internet centers (cyber kiosks). A critical security vector is an unattended session left open on a shared tablet or laptop.

To prevent unauthorized profile tampering, crop record alteration, or API key compromise, Kisan Dost enforces a strict 15-minute rolling inactivity session management engine across all authenticated views.

3.2 Technical Architecture & Lifecycle Flow

➔

3.3 Implementation Details (`lib/storage.ts`)

The inactivity tracker implements an optimized three-tier enforcement mechanism: 

export const INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes of inactivity

export function isSessionExpired(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const last = window.localStorage.getItem('kd_last_activity');
    if (!last) return false;
    const elapsed = Date.now() - parseInt(last, 10);
    return elapsed > INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function setupInactivityTracker(onTimeout?: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  recordActivity(); // Initial seed
  let lastRecorded = Date.now();
  const THROTTLE_MS = 10000; // 10s throttle prevents storage bottleneck

  const handleActivity = () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastRecorded >= THROTTLE_MS) {
      lastRecorded = now;
      recordActivity();
    }
  };

  // High-performance passive listeners
  const events = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart', 'click'];
  events.forEach((evt) => window.addEventListener(evt, handleActivity, { passive: true }));

  // Active interval checks every 10 seconds
  const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (isSessionExpired()) {
      clearAuthSession();
      window.location.replace('/login?timeout=1');
    }
  }, 10000);

  // Tab wake-up handler triggers immediately when user focuses tab
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && isSessionExpired()) {
      clearAuthSession();
      window.location.replace('/login?timeout=1');
    }
  });

  // Cross-tab sync: if logged out or active in another tab, harmonize state
  window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'kisan_farmer_profile' && !e.newValue) {
      window.location.replace('/login?timeout=1');
    }
  });
}

4 Security Architecture & Identity Governance

Immutable identifiers, cryptographic password rotation, and safe storage

4.1 Immutable Primary Farmer Identifier (Email/Phone Lock)

In previous iterations, allowing users to freely mutate their login email or phone number in profile settings created critical synchronization vulnerabilities:

  • Orphaned crop records and database foreign key mismatches.
  • Identity takeover or accidental lockout if a typo was submitted.
  • Token invalidation discrepancies between client storage and server session tokens.

Architectural Resolution: The primary login identifier (`phone_or_email`) is enforced as read-only across all profile forms, backed by database-level update guards. The field is clearly designated with a lock indicator and bilingual tooltip: "Primary login identifier cannot be modified. Contact farm administration for account re-assignment."

4.2 In-Place Cryptographic Password Change Architecture

Password modification is isolated into a dedicated cryptographic workflow:

🔒
Current Password Verification
Requires validation of the farmer's active password using bcrypt.compare before permitting any hash updates.
🛡️
12-Round Bcrypt Hashing
New passwords are generated with high salt work factors (12 rounds) on the server, mitigating rainbow table attacks.
📊
Real-Time Entropy Meter
Client-side validator scores password complexity based on length (>=8), uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols.
⚡
Session Invalidation
Upon successful password rotation, legacy sessions across alternative devices are automatically revoked.

4.3 Safe Client Storage Policy & Shared Device Purge

🔐
Zero Token Leakage Standard
Kisan Dost strictly prohibits storing raw JWT or bearer tokens in client-accessible localStorage or Javascript-readable cookies. All authentication cookies are dispatched with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict attributes.

When a session terminates (either via explicit logout or the 15-minute inactivity trigger), clearAuthSession() performs a comprehensive privacy cleanse:

  1. Notifies the server route POST /api/logout to expire the server-side cookie.
  2. Iterates through and removes all user-scoped AI chat histories (kd_chat_history_*, kd_chat_session_*).
  3. Wipes cached farmer UI profile (kisan_farmer_profile, kd_dashboard_profile).
  4. Purges the custom Gemini API key cache (kd_custom_gemini_key) and inactivity timestamps.

5 Database Architecture & Data Models

Neon Serverless PostgreSQL relational schema and integrity constraints

5.1 `farmer_profiles` Table Definition

The primary entity representing farm accounts, access credentials, and agricultural telemetry configurations: 

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS farmer_profiles (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  phone_or_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  district VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Faisalabad',
  land_acres NUMERIC(8, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.00 CHECK (land_acres > 0),
  primary_crop VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Wheat (گندم)',
  gemini_api_key_ciphertext TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Farm Manager & Owner',
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Optimized Performance Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_farmer_identifier ON farmer_profiles (phone_or_email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_farmer_district ON farmer_profiles (district);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_farmer_crop ON farmer_profiles (primary_crop);

6 Core Functional Agronomy Modules

Applied AI agronomy, satellite meteorology, wholesale pricing, and diagnostics

6.1 Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Multi-Agent Agronomist

The core intelligence layer utilizes Google Gemini 2.5 Flash configured with domain-specific agricultural prompts tailored for Pakistani farming realities.

  • Adaptive Language Routing: Automatically detects Urdu, English, or Roman Urdu queries and responds in the identical dialect.
  • Dual-Tier Key Model: Seamlessly allows farmers to use shared community keys (with usage quotas) or attach their personal Google AI Studio Key for unlimited, low-latency queries.
  • Context-Aware Injection: Injects the farmer's verified district, acreage, and active crop directly into prompt context.

6.2 Satellite Weather & Soil Telemetry Radar

Integrates directly with the Open-Meteo High-Resolution Satellite API, indexing Pakistan's primary agricultural districts (Faisalabad, Multan, Sahiwal, Sargodha, Rahim Yar Khan, etc.).

🌦️
7-Day Hourly Precipitation
Predicts rain onset and millimetric intensity, preventing fertilizer washouts and guiding pesticide spray scheduling.
💧
Evapotranspiration & Soil Moisture
Calculates daily moisture loss from soil and crop canopies to optimize tubewell runtimes and conserve groundwater.

6.3 Wholesale Mandi Intelligence Network

Aggregates daily wholesale commodities rates across major crop trading hubs in Pakistan (Wheat, Basmati Rice, Seed Cotton, Sugarcane, Maize, Potatoes). Computes day-over-day price deltas, 30-day volatility ranges, and provides wholesale trading advisories to maximize harvest margins.

6.4 Pest Doctor & Crop Disease Triage Engine

A multi-crop diagnostic matrix analyzing visual symptoms (leaf curl, yellow rust, boll rot, stem borer) with immediate bifurcated remediation:

  • Organic & Cultural Controls: Low-cost neem oil extracts, crop rotation, and beneficial insect preservation.
  • Chemical Formulations: Specific active ingredients, dilution ratios per 100L of water, and mandatory pre-harvest intervals (PHI).
